terms.BI: Business Interruption: cover for income lost when an insured site cannot trade after damage.
terms.ODS: Open Data Standards: the Oasis LMF family of open insurance data standards, including OED.
terms.OS: Ordnance Survey: Great Britain's national mapping agency, which publishes AddressBase and OS Open UPRN.
terms.PDF: Portable Document Format: a fixed-layout document file.
